game.title: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

football_evidence.question: Can the Cardinals’ pass defense slow the Rams’ passing game?
football_evidence.assessment: EdgeDesk’s number is 3.1 points closer to Arizona Cardinals than the line, and EdgeDesk cannot account for most of that. The measured football evidence leans toward Los Angeles Rams, not toward EdgeDesk’s number. Treat the gap as an open research question, not as an edge.
